title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
summary: Claude Cowork now includes a built-in, isolated browser enabling Claude to navigate websites and complete web tasks independently without needing access to the user's personal browser, addressing privacy concerns. Users can delegate web tasks like filling forms and pulling dashboard data while continuing other work. Rolling out this week to Pro, Max, and Team plans.

title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Anthropic's internal case studies show Claude Tag (bringing Claude into Slack conversations) accelerating workflows across teams: marketing synthesized discussions 60x faster, product ops compiled feedback in hours versus a week, and legal teams cut review time from a day to 30 minutes. The approach delegates research and synthesis to Claude while preserving human judgment for final decisions.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp's self-improving agent framework uses a two-skill architecture where an inner task-executing skill is continuously refined by an outer improver skill analyzing feedback, automating prompt improvement from typical ~80% to higher accuracy. Skills are treated as editable files in code review workflows, enabling reproducible and scalable agent development while keeping humans in control of changes.

title: Reducing cost and improving performance with Claude Platform
summary: Anthropic published guidance on cutting Claude Platform costs through prompt caching, removing outdated anti-patterns, and calibrating the effort parameter. New claude-api skill commands enable prompt auditing and cost optimization, with real-world benchmarks showing 50-73% cost reductions while maintaining or improving accuracy.

title: Building commerce agents with Claude
summary: Anthropic launched a commerce blueprint on GitHub with reference implementations for retail, travel, telecom, and ticketing. The blueprint includes integration points for catalogs, carts, and checkout, works across Claude API and cloud platforms (Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, Vertex AI), and shows real impact: 35% larger carts and 60% higher purchase completion rates.

title: A guide to the anatomy of effective commerce agents
summary: This guide recommends a single-agent-with-skills architecture for commerce applications, outperforming both one-prompt and multi-agent designs on quality, cost, and latency. It covers optimization strategies, production safety (including asynchronous memory and staged writes), and evaluation practices for non-deterministic agents.
